label: Model
words: Automatic uses your ChatGPT account when signed in (Settings → AI), else Claude Code or Codex.

label: Permission mode
words: yolo Nothing asks before editing files or running commands. Shift+Tab cycles it inside a session.

label: Auto-approve in panes
words: winfer code panes start in yolo mode (--yolo), overriding the permission above. Applies to started or restarted after change. Start mode: nothing asks before editing files running commands.

label: Plan sidebar
words: Shows the agent's plan in a sidebar on right when pane is wide enough, TUI and web UI; otherwise it stays above prompt. /sidebar toggles inside session.

label: Lean setup
words: Starts agents with fewer tools and skills, so every request is smaller. Applies to sessions started (or restarted) after the change.

label: Claude Code
words: When winfer code runs a Claude model: a short system prompt and only the tools coding needs (Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob, the plan tools, Agent, plus Skill when it has skills; no user MCP servers). In the bench: 71% fewer input tokens, 79% fewer at full price, same pass rate. Project CLAUDE.md and project skills still load.

label: Codex
words: When winfer code runs a Codex model: no ChatGPT apps, plugins and their skills, bundled skills, image generation, computer use, Codex's own browser or goals, no permission, apps and collaboration-mode instructions, only the skills picked below, and each tool result capped at 4k tokens. winfer's tools stay. In the bench: 37% fewer input tokens, same pass rate.

label: Short Codex prompt
words: Also swaps Codex's built-in system prompt (about 5k tokens) for a short one. In the bench: 52% fewer input tokens instead of 37%, same pass rate on 12 tasks, but Codex loses its own guidance tools.

label: Codex CLI panes too
words: Gives Codex CLI panes (not just winfer code) the same lean setup and output cap, with Codex's built-in prompt. Off by default: Codex runs as you configured it. A setup other sessions don't share may miss Codex's prompt cache, so it can cost more.

label: Skills
words: Loads all your skills (Claude Code also gets your user settings, hooks and plugins). Each skill's description goes into every request. Loads only the skills you pick below (Claude Code without your user settings, hooks or plugins). Picking none turns skills off. Claude Code's built-in skills and project skills still come along.

label: Context compaction
words: When a conversation fills the model's context window, these keep it going and save tokens.

label: Micro-compact at
words: Trims old tool output and file contents from earlier turns. Claude Code and Codex are briefly restarted between turns to apply it.

label: Full compact at
words: text-warning At or below micro-compact's level, so micro-compact never runs. Summarizes the conversation; Claude Code and Codex are asked to compact. With the ChatGPT account, winfer code uses its own tools; Claude Code and Codex use theirs. git, cargo, pnpm

label: Tools
words: With the ChatGPT account, winfer code uses its own tools; Claude Code and Codex use theirs.

label: Always-allowed commands
words: Commands starting with these run without asking, e.g. git, cargo, pnpm (ChatGPT account).

label: MCP servers
words: Extra servers for every backend, as JSON: font-mono { "name": { "command": "…", "args": [], "env": {} } } . winfer's own server is added automatically in panes. {}

label: Use local models
words: font-mono Run winfer code on a model served from your machine or network (vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, mtplx…), with winfer's own tools. The server needs the OpenAI Responses API ( /v1/responses local/<model> 127.0.0.1 Host

label: API key

label: Context window

label: Thinking levels
words: Comma-separated, as the model's chat template names them (Qwen3.8: font-mono low, medium, xhigh font-mono none turns thinking off. Empty: only the model default. When the server shows the model's chat template (llama.cpp), its own levels are used instead, and a picked level is fitted to them (e.g. font-mono high font-mono xhigh

label: Send level to chat template
words: Passes it as chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort, where llama.cpp, oMLX and MLX servers let the template read it. Turn off if your server rejects field.

label: Web search
words: Gives the models a web_search tool when server searches web (oMLX: its Web search settings pick provider and result count).

label: Connection
words: text-success text-danger Lists the server's models.

label: ChatGPT account
words: Runs the LLM below on your ChatGPT plan (Plus or Pro); no API key needed. Until you sign in, the Codex CLI's own login is used instead if Codex is installed. Set a weekly limit or disconnect winfer in ChatGPT's settings.

label: Hide names on plugin tabs
words: Plugin page tabs in the title bar show just their icon. Hover a tab to see its name.

label: Your own plugins
words: A folder with a plugin.json in the plugins folder shows up here, off until you turn it on. Reload after changing one.

label: Show task cost on panes
words: Each agent shows what its task has cost so far, at API prices, next to title: worktree's spend, or session's when it works in a shared folder.

label: Phone
words: Follow your agents from your phone: get a notification when one finishes or asks something, read its thread and answer it. Messages are end-to-end encrypted; the relay only passes them on.

label: Pair a phone
words: Scan the code with your phone's camera, open the page and add it to your Home Screen. On iPhone, notifications need iOS 16.4 or later and the Home Screen app.

label: Relay
words: Where winfer and your phones meet. Change it only if you run your own relay (relay/ in the winfer repo).

label: Export
words: Saves settings, workspaces, plugins with their data, and usage history into one file to import on another machine. Agent sign-ins, paired phones, browser logins and winfer code chats stay here.

label: Include secrets
words: ChatGPT sign-in, the voice OpenAI key and plugin vault values, encrypted with a passphrase you'll enter when importing.

label: Passphrase
words: The passphrases don't match. At least 8 characters. It can't be recovered. Leave empty to import without the secrets.

label: Import
words: Replaces this machine's data with an export, then restarts. Paths under the other machine's home folder are moved to this one's.

label: Channel
words: Stable: tested releases. Nebula: every change as soon as it lands.

label: Memory
words: winfer's own resident memory, sampled every 5 seconds into the log. A steady climb before a crash points at a leak; the timeline in the export shows it.

label: Terminals
words: Each live pane also holds up to 2 MB of replay scrollback in the backend, plus its xterm buffer in the webview.

label: Logs
words: winfer.log keeps the app and webview log (rotated at 5 MB); crash.log holds panics with backtraces — on Windows also a minidump per native crash. Both live in the folder below.

label: Verbose logging
words: Also records debug lines (more detail, faster-growing log). Kept across restarts.

label: Copy summary
words: Version, memory and the crash-log tail — paste it into a bug report.

label: Export for a bug report
words: A zip with the summary, both logs and the memory timeline. No settings, chats or secrets.

label: Latest crash
words: The end of crash.log. Full backtraces are in the file and in the export.
